snippet.title: This new voxel building game is INCREDIBLE
snippet.description:
VoxelMancy game: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4707120/VoxelMancy/
Online voxel sandbox where you can build anything imaginable. Forget simple cubes – sculpt slopes, curves, and structures of any size with many realistic materials. Your imagination is the only limit!
